Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 34
Federal
Nepal
Daily Agenda
Parliament
Thursday, Ashar 24, 2083
(Second Meeting)
5:35 PM
Information regarding messages
1. Information regarding messages received from the National Assembly.
Secretary of the House of Representatives, Prakash Adhikari, will provide information regarding the "Economic Bill, 2083" and the "Bill to Raise National Debt, 2083".
2. Table of Bills received from the National Assembly with messages.
Secretary of the House of Representatives, Prakash Adhikari, will table the "Public Procurement (Second Amendment) Bill, 2083", the "Property Infringement (Money Laundering) Prevention (Third Amendment) Bill, 2083", the "Cooperative (First Amendment) Bill, 2083", and the "Bill to Amend Some Nepal Laws Related to Health Science Education, 2083" along with messages received from the National Assembly.
Panch Prasad Pandey
Secretary General
